464943.cause: During operation of Freeport LNG's Liquefaction Plant, the facility experienced a trip of the Liquefaction Train 2. Train 2 tripped due to a mechanical issue. This incident resulted in unavoidable venting to the Liquefaction flare (EPN: LIQFLARE). Following refined calculations, it was determined that this incident did not exceed any reportable quantities as defined under 30 TAC §101.1.

465281.cause: During operation of Freeport LNG's Liquefaction Plant, the facility experienced a trip of the Liquefaction Train 1. Train 1 tripped due to an issue with the 11K-32 compressor system. This incident resulted in unavoidable venting to the Liquefaction flare (EPN: LIQFLARE).

466322.cause: During operation of Freeport LNG's Liquefaction Plant, Train 2 was brought down for maintenance work on the 12K-32 compressor system. This maintenance activity resulted in venting to the Liquefaction flare (EPN: LIQFLARE).

467180.cause: During operation of Freeport LNG's Liquefaction Plant, the facility experienced a trip of the Liquefaction Train 3. Train 3 tripped due to an issue with the 13K-31 compressor system. This occurrence resulted in unavoidable venting to the Liquefaction Flare (EPN: LIQFLARE).

467641.cause: During operation of Freeport LNG's Pretreatment Facility, Trains 1, 2, and 3 tripped due to an incoming power feed interruption. The trips resulted in unplanned and unavoidable venting to the Pretreatment Flare (EPN: PTFFLARE).

467647.cause: During operation of Freeport LNG's Pretreatment Facility, Trains 1, 2, and 3 underwent a restart after a trip caused by an incoming power feed interruption. The restart resulted in unavoidable venting to the Pretreatment Flare (EPN: PTFFLARE)
